decision: B. Obtain exact Mazaheri TSS schedule and interrupted pore data
evidence_for: boundary states and high-T comparator are incomplete
required_data: exact T1/T2/rates/holds plus switch pore/grain state

decision: C. Modify low-T2 closed-pore shrinkage/accommodation law
evidence_for: late densification is a candidate lever
evidence_against: closed pathway is not identified as dominant
required_data: open/closed fraction, closure density, trapped gas

evidence_against: OAT produces no pathway-consistent strict window

decision: E. Modify barrier extrapolation / low-T activity law
evidence_for: all T2 states are below fitted barrier range

decision: F. Add microwave-specific physics for HMS only
evidence_against: cannot explain thermal TSS boundary ordering
required_data: microwave field/temperature and matched thermal controls

decision: G. Stop model development and report negative thermal baseline
evidence_for: strict result is robustly negative in current audit
evidence_against: key pore and schedule data could still discriminate causes
